AI Customer Support

Zendesk AI

Zendesk AI adds AI agents, agent assistance, routing and service automation to Zendesk's customer-support platform.

What is Zendesk AI?

Zendesk AI brings generative and automated service capabilities into the Zendesk support stack. Organizations can use AI agents for automated resolutions, assist human agents with contextual support work and combine AI with Zendesk's ticketing, messaging and service-management workflows, with AI usage and feature depth depending on the purchased Zendesk plan and resolution allowance.

Best for: Support teams already using or considering Zendesk that want AI automation tightly integrated with ticketing and agent workflows.

Main features

  • AI agents for automated customer resolutions
  • Agent-assistance capabilities
  • Ticket triage and routing support
  • Knowledge-based customer answers
  • Messaging and service-channel integration
  • AI-agent developer APIs

Use cases

  • Automate common customer-service requests
  • Route and classify incoming tickets
  • Assist agents with faster responses
  • Provide AI support through digital messaging channels
  • Measure and expand automated resolution volume

Who is it for?

  • customer support teams
  • contact centers
  • support operations
  • enterprise service teams
  • Zendesk customers

Pricing and plans

subscription plus usage-based automated resolutions

Starting price: USD 19 / agent/month for the cited entry Zendesk support pricing; AI usage allowances may be separate

Check official pricing ↗

Advantages

  • AI is integrated with a mature ticketing and customer-service platform
  • AI agents are available within Zendesk service plans with usage allowances
  • Zendesk publishes developer APIs for AI-agent integrations

Limitations

  • Automated-resolution usage can create variable AI costs beyond base subscriptions
  • Available AI features and trial capabilities vary by plan
  • Pricing becomes more complex when combining base seats, AI usage and advanced add-ons

Frequently asked questions

Does Zendesk AI have a free trial?

Zendesk advertises a 14-day trial of its service platform. The exact AI capabilities available during a trial can depend on the trial configuration.

How is AI-agent usage billed?

Zendesk measures AI-agent consumption through automated resolutions and provides plan allowances or additional capacity depending on the commercial setup.

Does Zendesk expose AI-agent APIs?

Yes. Zendesk publishes developer documentation for its AI Agents APIs.
